cohort: The study included 79 pregnant women, categorized by BMI as normal weight, overweight, or obese, who underwent elective cesarean sections between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation.
finding: GSDMD and PANX1 levels were significantly lower in omental tissue of overweight and obese pregnant women compared to normal weight women, while levels in placental tissue were similar across BMI groups.
cross-section timing: During elective cesarean sections between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation (December 2021 to April 2022)
